anchor.title: Opens and closes their hands when you touch their palm.

items.title: Moves from sitting to being on their knees.
Prefers some foods over others.
Drags to get something they want.
Sits independently.
Walks or cruises while holding onto big furniture.
Shows different reactions to hot and cold things.
Likes some textures more than others.
Takes objects out of a container.

anchor.title: Brings their hands to their mouth.

items.title: Moves to the rhythm of music.
Clears the path to grab what they're after.
Matches sound to object, such as a doorbell with the door.
Tests cause and effect by dropping an object and seeing if you'll pick it up.
Looks for a toy that was just hidden.
Copies facial expressions.
Discovers things hidden under blankets or covers.
Listens with interest when you speak to them.

anchor.title: Moves their arms around when they see something they like.

items.title: Repeats 'baba' or 'dada' kind of sounds.
Knows what 'no' means.
Answers with babbles when you talk to them.
Babbles like they are in conversation with you and takes turns talking.
Refers to caregivers as 'mama' or 'papa.'
Looks at things or people when called by name.
Asks for help by babbling.
Uses sounds like 'm, n, p, t, d' when babbling.
Repeats sounds or actions to get people to look.
Gets upset when playtime is interrupted.
Lifts their arms to be carried.
Feels shy or anxious when meeting new adults.
Explores on their own with a caregiver nearby.
When they hear their name, they move toward the person by crawling, walking, or turning in their direction.
Shows preference for certain people.
Enjoys playing on their own.
